UNSW Scholarships for International Students Commencing Term 1, 2027

Residency: International. Opens 06/07/2026. Closes 30/10/2026. Status: Closed.

Please note this application will open on 06 July 2026 and close at AEST 11:59PM on 30 October 2026.

Eligibility

Must be an international student; and commence full-time study at UNSW Sydney in Term 1, 2027 in an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program.

Application required

Apply through the Scholarship Application Online portal.

ScholarshipValue
International Scientia Coursework Scholarship (PUCA1025)Offer 1: full tuition fee scholarship; Offer 2: $20,000 per annum
UNSW Law & Justice International Award (PUCA1028)$10,000 for 1 year
UNSW Business School International Pathways Award (PUCA1023)$15,000 for 1 year
UNSW Business School International Scholarship (PUCA1024)$5,000 for the minimum duration of the program
UNSW Hong Kong Foundation Scholarship (UGCA1603)$10,000 per annum for the minimum duration of the program. Be an international student, who is a citizen of Hong Kong at the time of application.
Dr Vincent Lo Asia Undergraduate Scholarship (UGCA1606)$10,000 per annum for up to 5 years. Be an international student from Asia.

No application required

ScholarshipValue
Australia's Global University Award (PUCA1026)$10,000 for 1 year
UNSW College Award (PUCA1027)$10,000 for 1 year
UNSW Masters of Laws Scholarship (PGCA1107)$20,000 for 1 year
UNSW Articulation Scholarships (UGCA1815, UGCA1817, UGCA1818, UGCA1825)$5,000 per annum as a stipend for the minimum duration of the program
